context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly implements a new Terraform resource with full CRUD operations, proper state management, diagnostics handling, and acceptance tests.

checklist.name: Create sets complete state
checklist.description: Create method calls POST /pet and sets ALL attributes in state from the API response including the server-assigned id. No computed attributes left unknown after apply

checklist.name: Read handles not-found
checklist.description: Read method calls GET /pet/{petId} and handles 404/not-found by calling resp.State.RemoveResource(ctx) instead of returning an error. Sets complete state on success

checklist.name: Update sets complete state
checklist.description: Update method calls PUT /pet and sets complete state from the response, not just the changed fields

checklist.name: Delete does not set state
checklist.description: Delete method calls DELETE /pet/{petId} and does NOT call resp.State.Set. The framework removes state automatically

checklist.name: Diagnostics checking
checklist.description: Every Plan.Get, State.Get, Config.Get, and State.Set call is followed by resp.Diagnostics.HasError() check with early return

checklist.name: Schema correctness
checklist.description: id is Computed with UseStateForUnknown. name and photo_urls are Required. status is Optional with enum validator. All attributes have Description strings

checklist.name: Framework types in model
checklist.description: Resource model struct uses framework types (types.String, types.Int64, types.List) not Go primitives

checklist.name: Provider registration
checklist.description: The new resource is registered in provider.go's Resources() method

checklist.name: API client
checklist.description: A separate client package or file with CreatePet, GetPet, UpdatePet, DeletePet methods using proper HTTP methods and JSON encoding

checklist.name: Acceptance test
checklist.description: Test uses resource.Test with ProtoV6ProviderFactories and CheckDestroy. Has at least a basic create-and-read test step with ComposeAggregateTestCheckFunc assertions. NOT unit tests with mocks
